blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM is suitable for …
blocks_element.text: OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM is suitable for sensitive skin, non-comedogenic, dermatologist tested, fragrance free, and formulated without parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or other common irritants. Based on its formula and clinical testing, it has been awarded the National Eczema Association Seal of Acceptance™. Additionally, it contains barrier-supporting and hydrating ingredients, including a Triple Lipid Barrier Complex (ceramides, cholesterol, and free fatty acids), ectoin, and tremella mushroom extract—ingredients generally recognized for their gentle and soothing properties. In consumer testing, 87% of users agreed the cream deeply moisturizes and comforts dry skin.1
